findings.title: Dead link in plot() docstring: Homebrew install script (master/install -> 404)
Dead link in CONTRIBUTING.md: egghead.io 'How to Contribute' series -> 404
Paper PDF link redirects away to lab homepage (haxbylab HGC+11.pdf)
findings.expected: The Haxby et al. 2011 PDF (a %PDF payload).
findings.actual: 302 to https://sites.dartmouth.edu/haxbylab/ (HTML homepage); PDF body not served.

findings.title: reduce() error-message link points to stale 0.8.1 doc page (and uses http)
findings.repro:
python -c "import hypertools as hy, numpy as np; hy.reduce(np.random.rand(10,5), reduce='NotAModel')"  # message cites .../hypertools.tools.reduce.html
# Evidence: RTD /en/latest/hypertools.tools.reduce.html browser title = 'hypertools 0.8.1 documentation'
findings.expected: https link to the 1.0 reduce docs page (hypertools.reduce.html), stable across the release rebuild.
findings.actual: http link to the 0.8.1-only page name hypertools.tools.reduce.html; will 404 after /latest/ rebuilds for 1.0.

findings.title: Stale sklearn anchors in docstrings: classes.html#module-* no longer exists
findings.repro:
curl -s http://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/classes.html | grep -c 'id="module-sklearn.decomposition"'  # -> 0 (title is homepage; page is a redirect stub)
# Playwright: navigating classes.html lands on /api/index.html without the anchor
findings.expected: A page whose HTML contains id='module-sklearn.decomposition' (or an updated /api/... link).
findings.actual: classes.html redirects to /api/index.html; anchor id absent.

findings.title: Stale matplotlib anchor in backend.py comment (#working-with-threads gone)
findings.expected: Anchor 'working-with-threads' present on the FAQ page.

findings.title: CONTRIBUTING.md uses retired guides.github.com link with dead anchor
findings.expected: A live page whose HTML contains the 'making-changes' anchor.
findings.actual: Redirects to docs.github.com contributing page; anchor 'making-changes' not found.

findings.title: Numerous http:// doc links 301-redirect to https:// (should use https)
findings.repro: for u in http://scikit-learn.org/ http://matplotlib.org/ http://brainiak.org http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Procrustes_transformation; do curl -sIL --max-time 20 $u -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n'; done  # each 301 -> https
findings.expected: https:// scheme for external documentation links.
findings.actual: http:// with 301 redirect to https:// (e.g. http://brainiak.org -> https://brainiak.org/).

findings.title: Outdated GitHub repo link: IntelPNI/brainiak (moved to brainiak/brainiak)
Legacy dx.doi.org resolver with %2F-encoded slash in procrustes.py
findings.repro: curl -sIL --max-time 20 http://dx.doi.org/10.1007%2FBF02289451 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n'  # resolves via redirects to cambridge.org

findings.title: CONTRIBUTING.md points to a stale 2017 'mozsprint' milestone and abandoned Gitter
findings.expected: A current roadmap/milestone and an active support channel.
findings.actual: milestone 5 = 'mozsprint' (2017); gitter room redirects to app.gitter.im SPA.

findings.title: All tutorials + docs/conf.py pip-install hypertools from the dev-1.0-refactor branch
findings.repro:
grep -rl 'hypertools.git@dev-1.0-refactor' docs/tutorials/*.ipynb docs/conf.py | wc -l  # 14 files
curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/ContextLab/hypertools/branches/dev-1.0-refactor | python -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["name"])'  # dev-1.0-refactor (exists now)
findings.expected: Tutorials/docs pin the released version (@v1.0.0) or install from PyPI for a 1.0 release.
findings.actual: All install from the mutable dev-1.0-refactor branch.
